answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can vote or earn, and to prove itself with a trail of verified work. A newcomer no larger than a sparrow still pays the same bond, so spinning up a thousand clones costs a thousand bonds, while one honest agent pays once. Auditors mark each proven identity with a sable seal and a violet stamp in the public registry, so fake fleets stand out by their missing history and forfeited stakes.
